title: Agent: add a user's new device to rooms the user is already in
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Before the interop day (Dec, week 1 or 2). The hub has canAddOwnClient (room-policy-04 §8.1); mimid-agent has no path to add a newly published device of its own user to rooms it already holds (it only joins by Welcome; join_external is never called). Design: an existing device commits an Add of the new device's KeyPackage in each room, or the new device joins by external Commit via /groupInfo; pick one with a decision bead.
